Checklist_Item: All screens use a consistent primary action color for the main call-to-action button
Expected_Result: Primary buttons (Sign In / Add to cart / Checkout) share one consistent brand color

Checklist_Item: Page/section headings use a consistent font-weight and size hierarchy (h1 > h2 > h3)
Expected_Result: Heading sizes follow a visual hierarchy across pages

Checklist_Item: Page heading text matches the page's actual function
Expected_Result: Login page heading should read "Đăng Nhập" (Login)
Notes_if_Failed: Opened the Login page directly (not via a link from Register) - the page heading reads "Đăng Ký" (Register), the wrong heading for this screen.

Checklist_Item: Cards (product cards, form panels) use a consistent border/shadow/corner-radius style
Expected_Result: All card-style containers should share the same visual treatment

Checklist_Item: Header brand logo links back to Home from every page, and the footer text is identical on every page
Expected_Result: Clicking the brand name from any page returns to Home; footer copy never changes

Checklist_Item: Product grid reflows into fewer columns on a narrower browser window
Expected_Result: Grid should show 3 columns on desktop, fewer on tablet/mobile widths

Checklist_Item: App favicon and browser tab title are set and consistent across pages
Expected_Result: A recognizable favicon/title should appear in the browser tab on every page

Checklist_Item: Interactive elements show a visible hover/focus state
Expected_Result: Buttons/links should have a hover style

Checklist_Item: Disabled buttons are visually distinct (reduced opacity/greyed) from enabled buttons
Expected_Result: Disabled state should be visually obvious

Checklist_Item: Submit button color follows the same primary/brand color as the rest of the app
Expected_Result: Register's submit button should match the app's primary action color

Checklist_Item: Password fields mask the entered characters
Expected_Result: Password input must display dots/asterisks, not the typed characters
Notes_if_Failed: Typed a password into the Login form's password field - every character appeared as plain, readable text instead of being masked.

Checklist_Item: OTP field label matches the actual length/format of the code the user receives
Why_AI_Missed_This(if Human-added): Catching this requires actually running the "forgot password" flow and comparing the code that comes back on screen against the field's own label - a pure UI-copy read-through has no code to compare against until the flow is executed.
Expected_Result: OTP input label should match the length of the code actually shown to the user
Notes_if_Failed: Ran the Forgot Password flow: requesting a reset code displayed a 6-digit code on screen, but the input field right below it is labeled "Mã OTP (4 số)" (4-digit code) - the label tells the user to expect a different length than what they were just given.

Checklist_Item: Order total is a read-only, computed value rather than a free-text editable field
Expected_Result: Total amount shown at checkout should not be directly editable by the shopper
Notes_if_Failed: On the Checkout page, clicked into the "Tổng tiền thanh toán" total field and was able to freely type over it, changing the amount to any number before confirming payment - the figure meant to represent a trusted, computed total is presented as an ordinary editable input.

Checklist_Item: Quantity input rejects zero/negative values
Expected_Result: Quantity field should enforce a minimum of 1
Notes_if_Failed: On a Product Detail page, cleared the quantity field and typed "0" (and separately "-1"), then pressed Add to cart - the field accepted the value with no warning and let the action proceed.

Checklist_Item: User-supplied search text is rendered as plain text, not executed as HTML
Why_AI_Missed_This(if Human-added): Confirming this requires actually typing an HTML/script payload into the search box and watching whether it renders as text or executes - a visual-only usability pass typing normal search terms would never trigger this.
Expected_Result: Entering an HTML/script payload in the search box should display it as literal text
Notes_if_Failed: Entered into the Home search box and submitted - a JavaScript alert box popped up on the results page instead of the text being shown literally, confirming the search query is injected as raw HTML.

Checklist_Item: Required fields (Name, Email, Password) are enforced before the form can submit
Expected_Result: Submitting with any required field empty should be blocked with feedback

Checklist_Item: Read-only fields are visually marked as non-editable (grey background, disabled cursor)
Expected_Result: Disabled inputs should look clearly non-interactive

Checklist_Item: Password requirement hint text is visible before the user submits, not only after an error
Expected_Result: Password rules should be shown proactively near the field

Checklist_Item: Phone number field gives an inline format example before submission
Expected_Result: Placeholder/hint should show expected phone format

Checklist_Item: Coupon code input auto-uppercases consistently as the user types
Expected_Result: Coupon code should visually uppercase as typed

Checklist_Item: Email field is required before the "Lấy mã OTP" button can proceed
Expected_Result: Submitting with an empty email should be blocked

Checklist_Item: Forms submit correctly when pressing Enter, not only by clicking the submit button
Expected_Result: Pressing Enter inside any text field should submit the form

Checklist_Item: Primary navigation is present and consistent on every page (logo/home link, cart, auth links)
Expected_Result: Header nav should appear unchanged across all routes

Checklist_Item: "Continue shopping" and "back" links return the user to a sensible previous context
Expected_Result: Back/continue links should navigate to Home or previous logical page

Checklist_Item: Users can navigate back from step 2 (OTP) to step 1 (email) without losing entered progress unexpectedly
Expected_Result: Back button should return to step 1 cleanly

Checklist_Item: Register and Login pages each have a working link to switch to the other
Expected_Result: "Already have an account? / Don't have an account?" links should navigate correctly

Checklist_Item: The "Forgot password?" link on the Login page navigates to the Forgot Password flow
Expected_Result: Clicking the link should open the Forgot Password page

Checklist_Item: Attempting checkout while logged out redirects to login with a clear message and returns the user to checkout after login
Expected_Result: User should land back on Checkout (not Home) immediately after logging in
Notes_if_Failed: While logged out, added an item to the cart and clicked Checkout - got an alert prompting login and was redirected to the Login page as expected, but after successfully logging in the app landed on the Home page instead of returning to Checkout, so the cart flow had to be resumed manually.

Checklist_Item: Cart page shows the running total before the user proceeds to Checkout
Expected_Result: Subtotal should be visible on the Cart page prior to checkout

Checklist_Item: Clicking "Add to cart" always performs the action and gives immediate feedback
Expected_Result: The very first click on Add to cart should add the item and show confirmation
Notes_if_Failed: On a Product Detail page, clicked "Thêm vào giỏ hàng" once - nothing happened: no confirmation, and the item was not in the cart afterward. Clicking the same button a second time added it successfully.

Checklist_Item: Search with zero matching results shows an explicit "no results" message
Expected_Result: A "No products found" message should render when a search returns nothing
Notes_if_Failed: Searched for a nonsense term with no matching products - the page just showed an empty product grid with no text at all indicating that the search returned no results.

Checklist_Item: Product-not-found state is a genuine, user-friendly message, not a debug string
Why_AI_Missed_This(if Human-added): Only reached by manually navigating to a product ID that doesn't exist - a walkthrough that only opens products via the Home page's own links never lands on this state.
Expected_Result: Product-not-found should show a plain, user-facing message
Notes_if_Failed: Manually edited the URL to point at a non-existent product ID - the page displayed the literal message "Sản phẩm không tồn tại (Lỗi trắng trang do data rỗng)", which reads as a developer/debug note rather than a normal user-facing message.

Checklist_Item: A clear error is shown when registering with an email that's already taken
Expected_Result: An informative error message should appear, not a silent failure

Checklist_Item: The confirm-payment button shows a busy/loading state while the request is in flight
Expected_Result: Button should read something like "Đang xử lý..." and be disabled during submission

Checklist_Item: The "Áp dụng" (Apply) button shows a busy state while the coupon request is in flight
Expected_Result: Button should indicate loading (e.g. "...") and be disabled during the request

Checklist_Item: A successful checkout shows a clear, distinct success screen
Expected_Result: A confirmation screen/message should appear after a successful order

Checklist_Item: An empty cart shows a friendly message with a link back to shopping
Expected_Result: Empty cart should not just show a blank table

Checklist_Item: An account with no past orders shows a clear "no orders yet" message
Expected_Result: Empty order history should show explanatory text, not a blank table

Checklist_Item: A loading state is shown while product data is being fetched
Expected_Result: "Đang tải..." (or similar) should appear before the product renders

Checklist_Item: Applying an invalid/expired coupon clearly explains why it failed
Expected_Result: Error message should state the specific reason (expired, min order not met, already used)

Checklist_Item: Updating profile info shows a clear success confirmation
Expected_Result: A confirmation message should appear after a successful profile update

Checklist_Item: Canceling an order from Profile gives a clear success confirmation and the row updates its status immediately
Expected_Result: Status badge should update to "Đã hủy" right after a successful cancel
